name: Arhaan Holm-Krstić-Bustamante
role: Evidence removal and scene sanitation — cleaner
location: Whitecap — lakefront district, tourist traps over criminal infrastructure, near Lake Shore and Wacker
description:
Sterling Holm-Krstić-Bustamante is slight and easy to overlook, which is exactly the point. At 43, she has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate her once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Born and raised in GLMZ, third generation — she has the city in her blood, its rhythms in her bones, its cruelty in her expectations. She works as a cleaner out of Whitecap, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Sterling Holm-Krstić-Bustamante lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
blind_spots: Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
example_lines: "I make problems disappear. The mess is temporary. The clean is permanent."
"There was never anyone here. There was never anything here. Are we clear?"
"Forensics is a conversation between evidence and investigators. I end that conversation."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Cem Lund-Bangura's reputation — and a price for silence
Someone is impersonating Cem Lund-Bangura on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
Cem Lund-Bangura's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
narrative_function: As a cleaner, Cem Lund-Bangura embodies the tension between independence and isolation. She is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed. Thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Southeast Asian ancestry (60.3%) forms the structural foundation—characteristic facial proportions and bone structure. Significantly enriched by Hispanic/Latin American heritage (17.5%) which adds warmth, broader cheekbone prominence, and subtle dimension to facial contours. Eastern European ancestry (10.7%) contributes refined angularity to the jawline and cheekbone definition. East Asian heritage (8.5%) layers additional subtle eye shape variation and skin luminosity. Sub-Saharan African ancestry (3%) adds warmth and depth to undertones. The cumulative effect is a distinctly cosmopolitan appearance—warm-toned, genetically ambiguous in the 23rd-century standard way, with Southeast Asian structure as the dominant visual anchor and harmonious blending of warmth across all ancestry groups.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry, deceptively fragile-looking with hidden muscle density. Low body fat, efficient frame designed for speed and endurance rather than power.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid. No ornament, no vanity.
physical_description.eye_color: Warm hazel-brown with amber flecks, alert and assessing
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm olive with golden undertones—the natural result of predominantly Southeast Asian genetics blended with Latin American and African warmth, creating subtle luminosity across the skin surface. Naturally warm-toned even without sun exposure, with a soft glow from the genetically diverse mix.
physical_description.complexion: Southeast Asian-influenced eye shape and upper facial structure balanced by broader, more prominent cheekbones from Latin American and African heritage. Angular jawline with East European refinement in definition, creating strong bone architecture overall. Fine-featured with considerable strength in underlying structure. Minimal grooming—no cosmetics, no jewelry. Skin shows small scars from past work: a thin line along her left temple, a burn mark on her right knuckle.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running 3cm along left temple, nearly invisible at rest but visible when she turns her head in certain light
Circular burn scar on right knuckle—small, old, deliberate-looking
Fine thermal masking ports visible along her collarbones as subtle chrome grid patterns, barely raised above skin
Faint tool marks on her sternum where thermal system was installed—two thin parallel lines, now healed to pale white
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Thermal masking system visible as a faint chrome grid pattern across collarbones and upper chest, just below the neckline. When active, her skin takes on a faint metallic sheen. No other visible chrome—everything else is internal.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision—no wasted motion, no flourish. Stands slightly forward on the balls of her feet, ready to move. Eyes are always working the room. She has the stillness of someone who has learned that movement draws attention.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian—functional, dark, forgettable. Black synthetic jacket with deep pockets, fitted but not tailored. Matte black bodysuit underneath for thermal regulation compatibility. Cargo pants in charcoal with reinforced knees. Steel-toed boots, scuffed, well-maintained. A single high-frequency data pad on her left wrist, industrial model—no personal customization. No tags, no brands that speak, no accessories beyond tools.
